We need to estimate distance between two cities. There\'s a function estimate_distance(cityA, cityB). But we need zipcodes? The function expects cityA and cityB as zipcodes. Actually the function signature: estimate_distance(_:{ cityA: string, cityB: string }). It says "The zipcode of the first city." So we need zipcodes. We can get zipcodes via get_zipcode_based_on_city. So we need to call get_zipcode_based_on_city for "San Francisco" and "Rivermist". Then call estimate_distance with those zipcodes.\n\nWe need to chain calls. We\'ll first call get_zipcode_based_on_city for San Francisco. Then for Rivermist. Then estimate_distance. We\'ll output the result. Let\'s do that.')
